title: Visited Positions Under Appended Choices
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $w,w'$ be finite binary words, let $c$ be a configuration on a fixed input, and choose a work tape $i$. Every head position visited on tape $i$ during the run under $w$ is also visited during the run under the concatenated choice word $ww'$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic machine with $k$ work tapes
A configuration $c$ on a fixed input
